$seats = 10
root = Stack([tabs1])
tabs1 = Tabs([tabPlans, tabCalc])
tabPlans = Tab("Plans", [g1])
g1 = Grid([cBasic, cPro, cTeam])
cBasic = Card("Basic", [mB])
mB = Metric("Price", "290 kr", "per month")
cPro = Card("Pro", [mP])
mP = Metric("Price", "490 kr", "per month")
cTeam = Card("Team", [mT])
mT = Metric("Price", "790 kr", "per month")
tabCalc = Tab("Calculator", [s1, mTotal, row1])
s1 = Slider("Seats", $seats, 1, 100)
mTotal = Metric("Monthly total", total, "49 kr per seat")
total = $seats * 49
row1 = Row([bReset])
bReset = Button("Reset", @Reset($seats))
